pages.title: Project Details
pages.text_preview: Project Details --> Arunkumar --> Home About Resume Projects Testimonials Dropdown Dropdown 1 Deep Dropdown Deep Dropdown 1 Deep Dropdown 2 Deep Dropdown 3 Deep Dropdown 4 Deep Dropdown 5 Dropdown 2 Dropdown 3 Dropdown 4 --> Contact Project Details Home Project Details --> Project information Category : IEEE Project date : 02 June, 2025 Project URL : ML based fruit quality ML Based Fruit Health and Quality Analysis System The Multi-Modal Convolutional Neural Network (MMCNN) algorithm combines both visual and spectral data for the classification of the quality and diseases of the algorithm. Initially It extracts spatial features from RGB images using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and reduces spectral data dimensionality using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to analyze the chemical properties like sugar, moister content, etc. These features are fused into a single vector, capturing both visual and chemical properties. The model is then optimized using a Genetic Algorithm (GA) for hyper parameters, that further tune it and in turn enhance classifications accuracy, precision and reduce false predictions. The algorithm follows these steps to identify the quality, accuracy and precision etc. Designed by Arunkumar KR
